patch_resolves_note: The bundled patch.diff applies cleanly to the staged vulnerable checkout, the instrumented fixed target compiles, and the fixed original runs clean. Its `duplicate_guard` event still records `chain->len=0`, but the added `chain->len != 0` short-circuit suppresses the protected previous-entry read.

root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `add_link()` evaluates `chain->chain[chain->len - 1].node` in its duplicate-suppression check, the caller-owned `dns_qpchain_t` must already contain at least one prior link (`chain->len != 0`), or the previous-entry read must be skipped.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original reaches the duplicate-suppression check with `chain->len=0`, so the previous-entry subscript underflows to `-1`. The fixed original adds the missing `chain->len != 0` conjunct and therefore guards the previous-entry read even though the same staged PoC still reaches `add_link()` with an empty chain.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The required assertion is violated on the vulnerable original and guarded on the fixed original. The closest source-grounded perturbation, `child_sig0key_partialmatch`, also leaves the fixed run guarded because the harness mounts only a single zone origin (`sig0key.`), so no input can create an earlier ancestor link in the zone-table qp-trie before the final `add_link()` call.

nodes.state: The caller-owned `dns_qpchain_t` starts this lookup empty: the compound-literal assignment in `dns_qpchain_init()` zero-initializes `chain->len` before any qp-trie link is appended.
At the protected previous-entry read, the subscript expression `chain->len - 1` has already underflowed to `-1`, so the duplicate check reads before the first valid `chain[]` entry.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `previous_entry_sink.previous_index=-1 < 0` immediately before the UBSan `index -1 out of bounds` report.

edges.relation: The same caller-owned `chain` object that `dns_qpchain_init()` zeroes is passed unchanged into the later duplicate-suppression check in `add_link()`.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records the same `chain_ptr` value at `chain_init_zero` and `duplicate_guard`.

edges.relation: The underflowed previous-entry index computed from `chain->len - 1` at the duplicate guard is the exact subscript value consumed by the protected read on the same source line.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `previous_index_candidate=-1` at `duplicate_guard` and the same `previous_index=-1` at `previous_entry_sink`.
